skill.name: wt-status
skill.description: Show comprehensive status of current and all git worktrees. Use when checking uncommitted changes, sync status, or getting overview of all active worktrees.
skill.body:
# /wt:status - Show Worktree Status

## Description
Quick command to show comprehensive status of the current worktree and all worktrees.

## Usage
```
/wt:status
```

## What It Does

This slash command:
1. Activates the Git Worktree Manager skill (`@git-worktree`)
2. Automatically runs the `*status` command
3. Shows detailed status information

## Information Displayed

The command shows:
- **Current worktree location** - Where you are now
- **All worktrees and their states** - Overview of all worktrees
- **Uncommitted changes** - Files modified, staged, untracked
- **Branches ahead/behind origin** - Sync status with remote

## Benefits

✅ **Complete Overview** - See everything at a glance
✅ **Sync Awareness** - Know what needs pushing/pulling
✅ **Change Tracking** - See all uncommitted work
✅ **Multi-Worktree View** - Status of all worktrees

generated_query: I'm juggling three feature branches in separate git worktrees for our project, and I need a quick status check before our standup. Can you show me the current state of all my worktrees? I want to see which worktrees have uncommitted changes (modified, staged, or untracked files), which branches are ahead or behind their remote counterparts, and what branch I'm currently on in each worktree. Also, highlight the worktree I'm actually in right now.

edit_instructions.target_text: - **Branches ahead/behind origin** - Sync status with remote
edit_instructions.rationale: Deleting the sync status information causes the skill to omit branch ahead/behind details required by the query.
